name: com.xengine.unityimporter
description: Shared Unity-asset direct import layer: Unity YAML parser, content sniffer, deterministic GUID sidecar resolution, and .mesh/.prefab/.mat importers that claim Unity-serialized files and delegate engine-native files. Extracted from com.xengine.genshin so any demo package (genshin, zonezero, ...) can build on it.
